import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = scanner.nextLong();
        long y = scanner.nextLong();
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        scanner.close();

        long bestNum = -1;
        long bestDen = 0;
        long i = 1;

        if (n >= 1) {
            do {
                long cand = (i * x) / y;
                if ((i * x - cand * y) > ((cand + 1) * y - i * x)) {
                    ++cand;
                }

                if (bestNum == -1 ||
                    (Math.abs(cand * y - i * x) * bestDen) <
                    (Math.abs(bestNum * y - bestDen * x) * i)) {
                    bestNum = cand;
                    bestDen = i;
                }
            } while (++i <= n);
        }

        System.out.println(bestNum + "/" + bestDen);
    }
}
